name: PinMap
description: Points with a status anywhere in the world, clustered with a status ring, over a token-themed vector basemap with the home region glowing in the data hue.
signature: ({ config, value, onValueChange, label, zoom, fallback, className }: PinMapProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: config
props.description: Typed component configuration and external provider definitions.

props.name: fallback
props.description: The area shown when there is no pin: [west, south, east, north]. Default: the world.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the map for assistive tech: "Map of 12 Example Lane".

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called when the pin is dropped, nudged with the arrow keys or placed by a click. Without it
the pin is fixed (a read-only preview).

props.name: value
props.description: The pin, or null for none yet.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Zoom used to show the pin. Default 16 (a street and its buildings).
